<!--
  The breadcrumbs of an inner page: the parent pages (links where they have an href) separated by chevrons; the
  last entry is the current page and is not a link.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { NavLink } from "../blocks/nav-bar.types";

  export type PageCrumbsProps = {
    label: string;
    crumbs: NavLink[];
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import { urlOf } from "../utils";

  let { label, crumbs, landmarkLabel }: PageCrumbsProps = $props();
  const last = $derived((crumbs?.length ?? 0) - 1);
</script>

<Block tag="nav" aria-label={(landmarkLabel ?? label)} data-slot="crumbs">
  <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-wrap items-center gap-2 p-0 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    {#each crumbs as c, i (c.id)}
      <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="crumbs-row">
        {#if (i < last)}
          {#if c.href}
            <Link href={urlOf(c.href)} variant="muted" size="sm" data-slot="crumb">
              {c.name}
            </Link>
          {:else}
            <Inline data-slot="crumb">
              {c.name}
            </Inline>
          {/if}
          <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" size={16} />
        {:else}
          <Inline class="font-medium text-foreground" aria-current="page">
            {c.name}
          </Inline>
        {/if}
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
</Block>
